title: Monetisation, Ad Placement, and Telemetry Semantics
authorityBoundary: This artefact defines monetisation capability classification, client telemetry envelope, ad placement taxonomy, and ad event audit and telemetry semantics. It does not create monetisation implementation, ad UI implementation, ad inventory, ad serving, ad SDK implementation, analytics provider setup, revenue reporting, telemetry provider integration, SDK implementation, dashboard, provider setup, app submission, legal conclusion, ads compliance, monetisation readiness, observability readiness, production readiness, live-provider readiness, product UI readiness, or human acceptance.

monetisationCapabilityClassification.rule: Every app-surface monetisation behaviour must classify its capability, provider posture, consent, privacy, audit, telemetry, proof, dependency, and non-claim boundary before implementation or readiness claims.
mustReject: monetisation behaviour without privacy and consent mapping
monetisation behaviour without audit and proof mapping
monetisation readiness claim without owner acceptance

clientTelemetryEnvelope.rule: Client telemetry must map interaction telemetry, diagnostics, performance, correlation context, consent state, privacy category, provider mode, environment, and evidence freshness to USF semantics.
clientTelemetryEnvelope.consentAwareSuppression: Telemetry that lacks required consent, privacy category, provider mode, environment, redaction, or proof mapping must be suppressed or rejected rather than emitted.
mustReject: telemetry without provider mode and environment mapping

adPlacementTaxonomy.rule: Ad placements must use USF-native placement categories with capability, consent, privacy, frequency, audit, telemetry, validator, proof, dependency, and non-claim mappings.
mustReject: ad placement without approved taxonomy category
ad placement without consent or privacy mapping
ad placement without audit and telemetry mapping

adEventAuditAndTelemetryModel.rule: Ad events must map impressions, clicks, rewards, consent, privacy categories, audit events, telemetry suppression, validators, proof, and non-claims before emission.
mustReject: ad event without consent and privacy mapping
ad event without audit event mapping
ad event without telemetry suppression posture

additionalSemanticModels.purpose: Define AdMob mobile ads semantics for ad units, consent, ATT, UMP, child-directed treatment, privacy data, audit events, telemetry, validators, proof, and non-claims.
Define AdSense web ads semantics for web ad surfaces, consent, regional rules, privacy data, audit events, telemetry, validators, proof expectations, and non-claims.
Define UMP and CMP consent flow semantics for ads consent requests, updates, denial, withdrawal, regional applicability, ATT interaction, validators, proof, and non-claims.
Define ATT-to-ads behaviour semantics for ATT status, consent state, personalised ads, non-personalised ads, ad loading, audit events, validators, proof, and non-claims.
Define personalised and non-personalised ads semantics for consent, ATT, regional restrictions, child-directed treatment, user settings, audit events, validators, proof, and non-claims.
Define regional restrictions and child-directed treatment for ads with region, age posture, prohibited placement, consent, validator, proof, and non-claim mappings.
Define ad frequency capping and session rule semantics for session boundaries, caps, pacing, consent, age posture, user experience, audit events, validators, proof, and non-claims.
Define rewarded, interstitial, banner, and native ad policy semantics for allowed ad formats, prohibited contexts, consent, reward semantics, audit, telemetry, validators, proof, and non-claims.

Define subscription and in-app purchase posture semantics for product catalogue authority, store products, entitlement effects, receipts, privacy, audit, validators, proof, dependencies, and non-claims.
Define web payment and payment-provider posture semantics for web payment capability, provider authority, privacy, audit, receipts, entitlements, validators, proof, dependencies, and non-claims.
Define revenue analytics and privacy constraint semantics for revenue events, privacy categories, consent, aggregation, audit, telemetry suppression, validators, proof, dependencies, and non-claims.

Define ads proof and compliance gate semantics for ads provider posture, consent, privacy, placement, regional restrictions, SDK registry, evidence freshness, validators, planted defects, and non-claims.
